checks.reference_match: Where Sol is visible, compare the COMPLETE original mascot at a similar size: silhouette, tip/lobes, red/orange/cream contour paths and widths, face/eye proportions and limbs. Do not pass a generic flame character. Where Sol is off-screen, compare the planned setting/props and approved frame pair without requiring him. Keep user design approval separate. Allow the latest requested small action-driven body/flame wobble; judge identity by recognizable compact design, coherent colored layers and settled endpoints, rather than requiring a rigid silhouette at every intermediate pose.
checks.eyes: Keep the normal open-eye design as the original navy #1C2447 ovals, with reference shape, size, low placement and close spacing. A brief natural blink may close and reopen both eyes, returning promptly to those original ovals. Keep the face attached to the body. No whites, highlights, extra pupils, unrelated expressive eye morphs, winks or facial-feature drift. No independent face slide/rotation, neck or body reshaping to fake a separate head turn.
checks.flame_and_limbs: Preserve the recognizable original flame design, red/orange/cream layer relationships, reference compact form and stubby limb lengths/attachment points. Allow small coordinated body/tip/lobe flex and soft follow-through tied to the main action, settling to reference endpoint proportions. Do not reject that requested bounce as a deformation by itself. Reject inflated or remodeled anatomy, independent layer slippage, uncontrolled stretching, new limbs or a different mascot. Keep feet supported unless a step/hop is scripted.
checks.framing_and_props: Match the active scene first/last crops, camera, required character/prop counts and physical attachments. Apply only episode-specific requirements; an earlier episode does not supply mandatory props for a new story.
checks.contacts_and_action: One main action with a short direct gesture path and the requested small coordinated bouncy flame-like follow-through, then a damped settle. Keep facial markings attached, eye ovals unchanged and limbs stubby. No unrelated windup, repeated nodding, endless idle sway, extra hops, skating or camera bounce. For human prop placement, maintain stable grip while lowering, support before release, stationary released prop and one clear withdrawal path; do not add mascot-style bounce to hands or mechanical props.
checks.mechanical_direction: Inspect consecutive real frames for the planned direction, rigid connections when present, and causal order of physical events. Do not infer correct movement or causality from a prompt, label, endpoint or successful decode.
checks.object_continuity: Maintain the identity and count of planned objects. A tracking mark, when present, stays attached to the same object and cannot jump, multiply or fade to fake movement. Fire may flicker or fuel may glow only as the approved action requires. Anchor actual fire to its ignition/fuel contact; any animated local lighting follows the two-frame cadence without unplanned whole-scene brightness pulsing. A transient painted effect must disappear completely when the shot requires it.
checks.start_end_states: The actual first/last footage frames match the user-approved stills and the required resulting pose/mechanism state.
checks.performance_and_timing: Inspect actual source-frame pairs on final 30 fps timeline: each pose/painted state unchanged for two frames, 15 pose updates per second at normal speed; longer holds use complete pairs. Apply to Sol, visible human hands, moving props, flames and animated local lighting. Background and painted surface texture stay stable. Reject interpolation, blending, optical-flow smoothing and motion blur concealing steps. Check source cadence before smooth editorial transforms, then final playback/crops. Verify planned action and ending hold against actual voice timestamps; no default Narrator face turn. Sol may be absent. Judge small bouncy body/flame follow-through as intended Sol performance under the latest user clarification. It must be connected to the action, readable on twos and settled at the approved end; a brief natural blink is permitted; unrelated eye morphs, prolonged squinting and facial sliding remain failures.
checks.clean_footage: No unintended text, logos, props, narrator on screen, audio or other generation artifacts. Inspect all frames, not only the endpoints.
checks.painted_art_style: Visible soft gouache-like brushwork, layered color, subtle paper texture and expressive painted shapes cover Sol, props and environment consistently. Forms use light/color without inked outlines. Compare the selected graphic references. A smooth logo-like mascot with only a grain overlay fails even if its geometry is correct. Preserve the source character and clear mechanical contacts through the paint.

review_rules: A technical probe or contact-sheet extraction is preparation, never a visual approval.
The user must see and explicitly approve BOTH first and last stills before video generation. The generator cannot approve them on the user's behalf.
A dedicated reviewer inspects actual evidence independently of generation. Every required check needs pass, fail or uncertain with evidence.
Fail, uncertain, missing evidence, missing user frame approval or a changed input blocks production approval.
Reviewing a clip does not authorize another paid generation. Preserve rejected takes.
Character geometry and painted art style must each pass. Approval of one does not establish the other or approve the complete frame pair.
Record frame-index/timestamp evidence for exact two-frame cadence, facial anchoring and hand-prop contact. Prompt wording or 30 fps metadata alone does not prove these checks passed.
